name: Entity Group Field lite
description: Attaches a computed group-reference field (one per group type) to content entities and ships a select/checkbox widget to join or leave those groups from the entity's own edit form.
project_description: Entity Group Field lite links content entities to Group (drupal/group v3) entities through per-group-type computed entity-reference fields. For every group type on the site it exposes a read-only computed base field (group_<group_type_id>) on the host entity types/bundles that a group relation plugin targets; enabling that field on the entity's Manage form display and assigning the shipped 'Group select list' widget lets editors attach or detach the entity to groups directly from its own edit form. The widget is a plain no-AJAX select that collapses to a single checkbox when only one group is selectable, supports customizing the field label, disables options the user may not use (via Form Options Attributes), and supports multiple relationships. It is a lighter-weight alternative to the Entity Group Field module and is not meant for relationships whose group-content has its own fields to fill in.
